title: PAR-134 MLEADERSTYLE CMC flags/index retention and DXF no-loss guard
mode: generated AC1024 DWG object-vector and ASCII/Binary DXF fast slice
scope: Retain raw CMC flags, reserved index, and metadata-presence state for MLEADERSTYLE leader, text, and block colors
Replay supported C0-C3 optional-name flags, including flagged-empty values, through DWG rewrite
Reject malformed CMC provenance before DWG output and clear DWG-only state on scalar DXF color edits
Refuse unsupported or lossy CMC method/flags/index state before scalar-only MLEADERSTYLE DXF output

odaSpec.version: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1
odaSpec.finding: ODA §2.11 specifies R2004+ CMC as a zero reserved BS index, packed BL method/value, and RC flags introducing optional color-name/book TV strings. §20.4.87 identifies MLEADERSTYLE groups 91, 93, and 94 as CMC fields.

localSource.finding: The parser and writer retained normalized values, method, RGB, and names but did not complete raw flags/index provenance and fail-closed scalar-DXF projection for all three style colors. DXF scalar edits could leave stale DWG-only metadata.

productionSummary: Bounded parsing captures raw flags and reserved index for leader, text, and block CMC colors; copy/reset state and metadata-presence handling cover all three fields.

DWG preflight validates method/scalar/RGB agreement, zero reserved index, known flags, string/flag consistency, and detached R2007+ string storage before writing; supported source flags replay exactly, including flagged-empty names.
Scalar DXF color edits clear only the corresponding DWG CMC provenance and companions.
Scalar-only MLEADERSTYLE DXF output rejects unsupported methods, invalid scalar/method combinations, optional CMC flags, RGB/names, and nonzero reserved indices before record publication.
changes.publicApiOrLayoutNote: CMC provenance fields are appended to DRW_MLeaderStyle; its public object size increases, so downstream consumers must rebuild.

generatedControls.wireWalk: An independent AC1024 cursor decodes each reserved BS index, packed BL method/value, RC flags, and optional detached strings for C0 ByLayer, C3 ACI, and C2 RGB fields.
generatedControls.parserRetention: Production parse/readback checks flags/index/presence for all three fields, following style fields and owner handles, a flagged-empty name, a structurally aligned nonzero reserved index, unknown 0x80 flags, and the existing C5 method mutation.
generatedControls.lifecycle: Copy, assignment, reset, and DXF scalar group updates verify provenance retention or clearing for all three style colors.
generatedControls.failClosed: Generated encoders reject nonzero index, unknown flags, unflagged strings, unsupported methods, method/value disagreement, missing detached storage for a flagged-empty name, and malformed state in every color slot before writing. ASCII and Binary DXF controls reject C5, flagged-empty names, nonzero indices, missing/invalid raw methods, and method/scalar mismatch before publishing bytes; faithful C0/C1/C3 scalar mappings remain accepted.

validation.strictBuild: cmake --build build-gcc --target libdxfrw_dwg_object_vectors_tests libdxfrw_wave1_tests dwg2dxf lc3_compat_check -j4
validation.diffCheck: git diff --check -- src/drw_objects.cpp src/drw_objects.h src/libdxfrw.cpp tests/dwg_object_vectors_tests.cpp tests/wave1_tests.cpp

evidenceLimits: Generated vectors establish local wire/parser/writer consistency, not independent producer semantics for MLEADERSTYLE CMC values.
Unknown CMC methods and C4/C6-C8 payload semantics remain unqualified; HATCH C5 producer behavior is unresolved and no new interpretation is introduced.
No persistent drawing fixture, external producer, native CAD application, independent semantic route, full suite, or platform qualification was run.
No support claim was promoted. J256, J260, J268, J284, J293, and J295 remain DEFERRED_EXTERNAL and non-promoting.
The shared worktree remains broadly dirty; this slice is uncommitted and unstaged.
